properties.headline: Dust Advisory issued October 16 at 12:49PM MST until October 16 at 1:45PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Dust Advisory for...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 145 PM MST.

* At 1249 PM MST, a plume of dust was located 6 miles northwest of
Bapchule, or 6 miles southwest of Sun Lakes, and was stationary.

HAZARD...Less than one mile visibility with strong winds in excess
of 30 mph.

SOURCE...Satellite and traffic camera observations.

IMPACT...Hazardous travel.

* Locations impacted include...
Mainly rural areas of Pinal County.

This includes AZ Route 347 between mile markers 180 and 184.
properties.instruction:
Blowing dust brings reduced visibility, leading to dangerous driving
conditions. If driving, avoid blowing dust if possible. If caught in
dense blowing dust, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep
your foot off the brake.

To report hazardous dust conditions, contact the National Weather
Service, or your nearest law enforcement agency, who will relay your
report to the National Weather Service office in Phoenix AZ.

waterways near high tide starting on Sunday, and continuing
into Monday and potentially through mid week.

unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone

dangerous surf conditions.

properties.headline: Dust Advisory issued October 16 at 12:46PM MST until October 16 at 2:45PM MST by NWS Phoenix AZ
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Phoenix has issued a

* Dust Advisory for...
Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 245 PM MST.

* At 1246 PM MST, a plume of dust was located near Casa Grande, and
was stationary.

HAZARD...Less than one mile visibility with strong winds in excess
of 30 mph.

SOURCE...Satellite observations.

IMPACT...Hazardous travel.

* Locations impacted include...
Casa Grande, Coolidge, Randolph, La Palma, Coolidge Airport,
Stanfield and Valley Farms.

This includes the following highways...
AZ Route 87 between mile markers 126 and 133. AZ Route 287 between
mile markers 111 and 120. AZ Interstate 10 between mile markers 188
and 195.
properties.instruction:
Blowing dust brings reduced visibility, leading to dangerous driving
conditions. If driving, avoid blowing dust if possible. If caught in
dense blowing dust, pull off the road, turn off your lights and keep
your foot off the brake.

To report hazardous dust conditions, contact the National Weather
Service, or your nearest law enforcement agency, who will relay your
report to the National Weather Service office in Phoenix AZ.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 16 at 2:36PM CDT until October 20 at 12:00AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Oklahoma...

Canadian River at Norman affecting Cleveland and McClain Counties.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Canadian River at Norman.

* WHEN...From Saturday evening to late Monday night.

* IMPACTS...At 98.0 feet, Flooding to depths of 4 feet occurs over
areas along and near the river on the Cleveland-McClain County
border from near Moore and Norman... to areas near Noble.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:00 PM CDT Friday the stage was 91.5 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 94.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
tomorrow evening to a crest of 98.0 feet early Sunday afternoon.
It will then fall below flood stage Monday evening.
- Flood stage is 94.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 98.2
feet on 05/07/2015.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 245 AM CDT.
